name: PSP Projects Limited
summary: PSP Projects Limited, a construction company, provides construction and allied services for industrial, institutional, commercial, residential, hospitality, hospital, and landmark government projects in India. It constructs industrial buildings for pharmaceutical plants, food processing units, engineering, manufacturing and processing facilities; and buildings for hospitals and healthcare services, educational institutes, shopping malls, hospitality services, and corporate offices.
